Container Office in Haridwar

SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of container offices for Haridwar. We build each unit to order at our own factory and dispatch it ready to use to your site in the SIDCUL Integrated Industrial Estate, BHEL Ranipur, Bahadrabad and across Haridwar city. If you need a site office, admin cabin or supervisor cabin, you deal with the maker, not a reseller. See our full Container Office Manufacturer for Haridwar SIDCUL Estate range for models, sizes and finishes.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. It arrives fully finished — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — so your team can move in the day it lands. For a planned estate like SIDCUL Haridwar, that means no site masonry, no wet work and no long build time.

Who buys a container office in Haridwar

Haridwar runs on large FMCG and pharma plants, BHEL Ranipur and its ancillary vendors, packaging units and auto-component suppliers. Most Haridwar enquiries reach us from:

  • SIDCUL vendor units needing an admin or QC cabin next to the shop floor
  • BHEL ancillary and fabrication units needing a supervisor cabin
  • Contractors on plant-expansion and civil projects needing a temporary site office
  • Warehouses and logistics yards on the Delhi–Haridwar belt needing a gate or dispatch office

These are administrative and site cabins. We build them as clean, insulated work spaces — not as process or storage structures.

Where we deliver in and around Haridwar

We supply container offices across the main industrial pockets of Haridwar:

  • SIDCUL Integrated Industrial Estate and Shivalik Nagar — 249403
  • BHEL Ranipur and Sector-III BHEL ancillary area — 249403
  • Bahadrabad industrial belt — 249402
  • Haridwar city and nearby project sites — 249401

We also serve the wider Roorkee–Haridwar corridor. Tell us your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGuard post or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftStandard site or admin officeMost common for SIDCUL units
40 ftLarge office or cabin-plus-meeting layoutCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation. Need a two-unit or two-storey layout? We build that too — ask for a prefabricated container office made for planned estate plots.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Haridwar uses the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with GI sheet
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so you get an honest price.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your team works. Common additions for Haridwar sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Greater Noida factory

Haridwar is served from our Greater Noida factory on North-zone dispatch. The road route runs via the Delhi–Meerut Expressway, then the NH corridor through Meerut, Muzaffarnagar and Roorkee into Haridwar — roughly 190–220 km depending on your plot. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; long-haul cost and crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the region? See our Meerut container office page for NCR sites, the container offices we route through the Delhi NCR hub, and our Chandigarh Tricity container office builds.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Haridwar

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size, panel type, insulation, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the Haridwar delivery distance. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Haridwar?

There is no single fixed price. Cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and delivery distance to your Haridwar site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote.

Do you deliver to SIDCUL Haridwar and BHEL Ranipur?

Yes. We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory to the SIDCUL Integrated Industrial Estate, Shivalik Nagar, BHEL Ranipur, Bahadrabad and Haridwar city, via the Delhi–Meerut Expressway and Roorkee corridor. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

What sizes of container office are available?

We build 10 ft, 20 ft and 40 ft standard units, and customise layouts such as partitioned, two-unit or two-storey cabins. Internal usable area is confirmed at quotation.

Can the container office be shifted to another Uttarakhand site later?

Yes. A container office is a self-contained steel cabin, so it can be lifted and relocated to another plot in Haridwar or elsewhere in Uttarakhand when your project moves.

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your container office in Haridwar, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
